tactics: intro α p xs as sep h

intro α p xs as sep h <;> induction xs with | nil => simp [h] | cons hd tl ih => (obtain ⟨hd1, tl1, h1'⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (List.splitOnP_ne_nil (p := p) (xs := tl)); by_cases h' : p hd <;> simp [*])
intro α p xs as sep h <;> induction xs <;> simp_all [List.splitOnP_cons]
